24/7 MXDR SERVICE
Managed SecOps for Microsoft Security Customers
Tailored protection to stop attacks and prevent future threats so you don’t have to.
Watch Video
Don’t settle for one size fits all managed security. Experience twenty four seven threat detection and response, prioritizing empowerment and innovation. Ontinue blends AI and human expertise to safeguard your environment using your existing Microsoft security solutions. With strong security posture, you can get back to family races or catching waves. However you recharge, it’s time to get back to you. That’s the power of Nonstop SecOps.
Protecting Organizations Around the World.
WE’VE GOT YOUR BACK. YOU FOCUS FORWARD.
99.5% of alerts are resolved without you lifting a finger.
We built our service on an AI-first platform that augments human expertise to enable smarter, faster decision-making, smoother teamwork, and total transparency every step of the way.
MANAGED SECOPS THAT JUST WORKS
Nonstop Protection. 24/7 Peace of Mind.
DETECT & RESPOND
Contain Threats Fast. Really Fast.
We augment our world-class Cyber Defense Center with an AI-first SecOps platform that leverages automation and Agentic AI to resolve incidents in minutes rather than days.
Infors escalations reduced to near zero
ASSESS & PREVENT
Reduce Risk. Strengthen Posture.
Prevent future threats from materializing. Our prioritized, actionable guidance, helps you harden your security posture for measurable results.
ACR's Secure Score Improved to 70% Above Average
CUSTOMIZABLE OPERATIONS
Tailored to How You Work.
Define when, who, and how we escalate an incident. We’ll automate your operational model to empower fast decision-making when you need it most.
SEE HOW METROHM SAVES TIME WITH AUTOMATION
MAXIMIZE ROI
Get More From Your Microsoft Investment.
We put your Microsoft Defender and Sentinel to work for you. Reduce ingestion costs, consolidate legacy security tools, and ensure your Microsoft investment is being operationalized to protect you.
DO&CO SAVES 40% YOY ON SECOPS DATA COSTS
Ontinue + Microsoft
Augment Your Team with Award-Winning Microsoft Experts
Our team of Microsoft Experts:
Strategize on Microsoft tool adoption and legacy tool consolidation
Deliver best practice deployment and configuration of Microsoft tools
Help you discover and test drive new Microsoft Security products and capabilities
